name: Princess Cage -Host to Hime to Uso no Koi-
original_name: プリンセスケージ -ホストと姫と嘘の恋-
source:
Kabukicho—There exists a night town where people wander in search of healing. Tetsuro, the story's protagonist, works there as a host who turns women's goodwill into money as he lives his dull everyday life...

...That was when he met her. A lonely girl named Asuka who seeks for true love. Thus begins her life in the sensual love business.

"Do you really love me? ...Or is money all you think about?"

Will he continue to deceive her for money? Or will he elope with her—Between continuing his job as a host or finding true love, which will he choose?

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/07/08/kagotori/]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
歌舞伎町——这里有一座不夜城，人们四处徘徊，只为寻求慰藉。故事主角Tetsuro在这里当男公关，靠着把女性的好感变成收入度日，日常生活乏味无趣……

……直到他遇见了她。一位名叫Asuka、渴望真爱的孤独女孩。她就此踏入这场充满情欲的恋爱交易。

“你真的爱我吗？……还是你眼里只有钱？”

他会为了金钱继续欺骗她吗？还是会和她私奔？在继续做男公关与寻觅真爱之间，他会如何选择？

[译自：[url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/07/08/kagotori/]官方网站[/url]]
